description:
Review of wave 1 (spec + standards, defk-vku): (1) generated rewrites must compile ('A suggestion must compile'): the Enum.min_by/max_by rewrite (errors.ex ~1060) uses an undefined key(...) and tracks the index while min_by returns the element; Enum.min/max over a non-variable source uses an undefined 'first'; find_index uses 'found?'. Make each either compile (test it) or drop the rewrite and keep only the hint. (2) attempt/1 turns ANY crash into :error after the first rejection, hiding internal compiler bugs: only catch defk's own rejection, re-raise anything else. (3) errors.ex 'why' says 'native function', a term CONTEXT.md avoids. (4) Smells worth fixing now: the builtin list lives in three places (Errors @builtins, compiler @math1, elixir_mode builtin/... guard): make one source; compile/4 repeats the Process.put(:defk_ctx/:defk_fun)+attempt shape three times: one helper; reject!/2 is a middle man over err!/4.

Done when a test compiles every dynamically generated rewrite form, an injected internal crash in a later kernel surfaces, and mix test passes.
title: Fix compile-error rewrites and stop hiding internal compiler crashes
